headline: Stlican Shelf Weathered Expanse Lead Fronts
war_summary: Since the 03:00 edition the fighting has sharpened on six sectors. Stlican Shelf now records the heaviest recent turnover with eleven ownership changes in the last two hours and forty‑six in the past day, and both factions’ casualty rates are accelerating on the two‑hour comparison. Weathered Expanse remains a blood‑soaked corridor, logging eight flips in two hours and fifty‑two in twenty‑four, though its one‑hour casualty trend eases while Warden losses accelerate over two hours. Linn Mercy stays busy with six events in two hours and nineteen overall, its casualties cooling hourly but climbing on the two‑hour window. Callahan’s Passage has awakened, posting four flips in two hours and sixteen total, with casualties cooling short‑term but rising on the two‑hour measure. Viper Pit adds three recent changes and twelve daily, its short‑term casualty rates falling yet accelerating over two hours. Marban Hollow contributes two fresh events and thirteen daily, casualties steady or cooling. Elsewhere Dead Lands, Godcrofts and Fisherman’s Row have gone quiet. Enlistments are climbing on all active fronts, signalling fresh troop commitments.
